title: Ghost in the Kernel
description: A privileged process is behaving outside its assigned capability boundary. Find the escalation path, revoke the compromised authority and restore kernel trust.
briefing: Aegis telemetry has flagged a process requesting memory access beyond its assigned capability set. The process is still contained within the fictional training environment. Validate the evidence before applying a kernel patch.

objectives.title: Inspect the memory anomaly
objectives.description: Review the process memory map and identify the suspicious privilege transition.

objectives.title: Revoke the compromised token
objectives.description: Invalidate the process capability token and prevent further privileged requests.

objectives.title: Apply the kernel security patch
objectives.description: Deploy the verified training patch to close the simulated privilege boundary weakness.

objectives.title: Isolate the compromised process
objectives.description: Move the detected process into the simulated quarantine.

objectives.title: Audit kernel integrity
objectives.description: Verify the kernel trust state and record the incident evidence.
